team.ai-ay.beat: A lady on the bay waves a sail marked ai and ay, and the apprentice learns the long a sound.

team.ee-ea.beat: Seaweed and beans show ee and ea, which both say long e.

team.oa-igh.beat: A raincoat, a boat and a high kite show oa, oe, igh and ie for the long vowel sounds.

team.oo-ew.beat: A balloon and a blue sky show oo and ew, which can say the long oo sound.

team.au-oi.beat: A hawk and a coin on the deck show au, aw, oi and oy.

team.ou-ow.beat: A brown owl and a rainbow show ou and ow, which can say two different sounds.

team.mix.beat: A harbor breakfast mixes every team pattern, and the apprentice reads the whole menu.
